summary: Comprehensive frontend testing of the GDPR/EU cookie consent implementation for SmartClout (PL/EN). All 10 requested flows passed: first-visit banner, Accept-all, Reject-all, Settings modal with 4 categories, FAB reopener, Privacy Policy page (/polityka-prywatnosci) with 9 sections, footer links, EN language switch, mobile responsiveness (390px, no horizontal overflow), and no regressions on the homepage. localStorage key 'smartclout_consent_v1' persists correct shape and values on every action. No JS page errors captured.
critical_code_review_comments: Minor: When the language is toggled while the cookie modal is already open, the modal title/body text does not appear to re-render immediately (test 8 check for 'Privacy' in the open modal returned False). Banner and re-opened modal do render correctly in EN after a fresh open. Non-blocking; consider re-rendering modal texts on i18n language change.
seed_data_creation: None. Only localStorage key 'smartclout_consent_v1' toggled during test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Cookie consent is fully working. localStorage key 'smartclout_consent_v1' shape: {v:1, ts:ISO, prefs:{necessary,functional,analytics,marketing}}. All data-testids exist as spec'd. Preview URL: https://78bf25b2-3c36-42fa-8f2d-4e2c3222081c.preview.emergentagent.com. Privacy page at /polityka-prywatnosci renders 9 sections with data-testid=privacy-section-1..9.
